description: Java class implementing a message deduplication node for Thingsboard rule engine, handling message deduplication strategies within a configurable time window.

classes.name: TbMsgDeduplicationNode
classes.description: Java class implementing a message deduplication node for Thingsboard rule engine, handling message deduplication strategies within a configurable time window.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, setting deduplication interval and queue name.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, processing deduplication timeout or regular messages.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions.

methods.name: processOnRegularMsg
methods.description: Processes regular messages, adding them to deduplication map or failing if max pending messages reached.

methods.name: processDeduplication
methods.description: Performs deduplication logic, creating output messages based on strategy (FIRST, LAST, ALL).

methods.name: scheduleTickMsg
methods.description: Schedules a self-message for deduplication timeout handling.

methods.name: findValidPack
methods.description: Finds a valid message pack within the deduplication interval.

methods.name: enqueueForTellNextWithRetry
methods.description: Enqueues message for next node with retry logic on failure.

methods.name: getMergedData
methods.description: Merges a list of messages into a JSON array string.
